title: Count Substrings Divisible By Last Digit
summary: Given a string s made of digits, count the substrings where the substring's value is divisible by its non-zero final digit, including those with leading zeros.
statement: Given a string s made of digits, count the substrings where the substring's value is divisible by its non-zero final digit, including those with leading zeros.
constraints: s has 1–100,000 decimal digits and substrings may have leading zeros.
A substring qualifies only when its final digit is nonzero.
Count substrings whose integer value is divisible by that final digit.
hints: Only remainders modulo digits one through nine are needed for future divisibility checks.
Maintain remainder counts for all substrings ending at the previous position under each possible modulus.
Append the new digit to every remainder, add the one-digit substring, then read remainder zero for the nonzero last digit.
The transition represents every substring ending here exactly once, and its selected modulus equals its final digit.
